name: LENNAR CORP /NEW/

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended November 30, 2025, Earnings Per Share note: 'Denominator for basic and diluted earnings per share — weighted average common shares outstanding 257,746' (in thousands) for FY2025 (FY2024 272,019, FY2023 283,319 in the same table); the same combined basic-and-diluted denominator is reported in the Q4/FY2025 earnings release. Lennar reports a single basic-and-diluted denominator (no dilutive securities outstanding; the filing states there were no antidilutive options for FY2023-2025).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — EDGAR companyfacts carries only the basic tag (WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic) for FY2025, while the filer's own 10-K EPS note states that the basic and diluted denominator is the same 257,746,000 shares. The value is the filer's reported diluted denominator for the missing period, within 0.95x of the last filed diluted count (272,019,000 in FY2024).
